## 1.2 Data wrangling

```{r wrangling_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Food Data (n=424) ----
food_data <- ffq_data |>
  dplyr::select(contains(c("participant_id", "food_insecurity", "total"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(-c(participant_id, food_insecurity), as.numeric)) |> 
  ## dropping partiicpants who weren't asked about food insecurity (preliminary FFQ)
  filter(!is.na(food_insecurity)) |> 
  mutate(participant_id = ifelse(participant_id == "NDF7038", "NSF7038", participant_id),
         participant_id = ifelse(participant_id == "NSF705", "NSF7025", participant_id))


## considering "study participants" as those who completed the FFQ w/ food insecurity question
study_participant_ids<- food_data |> pull(participant_id)


## Long Survey Health Data (n=273)----
long_survey_health_data <- long_survey_data |>
  filter(participant_id %in% study_participant_ids) |> 
  dplyr::select(c(participant_id, gender, age, systolic_1, diastolic_1, systolic_2, diastolic_2,
                  systolic_3, diastolic_3, height, weight, body_fat)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("systolic"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("diastolic"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("height"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(across(contains("weight"), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age)) |>
  mutate(body_fat = as.numeric(body_fat)) |> 
  mutate(average_systolic  = (systolic_1 + systolic_2 + systolic_3) / 3) |>
  mutate(average_diastolic = (diastolic_1 + diastolic_2 + diastolic_3) / 3) |>
  mutate(MAP = average_diastolic + (average_systolic - average_diastolic) / 3) |>
  mutate(BMI = weight / (height)^2) |> 
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(BMI < 10|BMI > 60, NA, BMI))

## Long Survey SOL Data (confirmed no NAs) (n = 273)----
long_survey_sol_data <- long_survey_data |>
  filter(participant_id %in% study_participant_ids) |> 
  mutate(material_wall_index = 0) |>  # bamboo, rafia, travelers_palm default to 0
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "wood",          1, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "burnt_brick",   2, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "metal_sheets",  3, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_wall_index = if_else(material_wall == "cement",        4, material_wall_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_roof_index = 0) %>%  # bamboo, thatch default to 0
  mutate(material_roof_index = if_else(material_roof == "metal_sheets",  1, material_roof_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_roof_index = if_else(material_roof == "cement",        2, material_roof_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_floor_index = 0) %>%  # bamboo, dirt, travelers_palm default to 0
  mutate(material_floor_index = if_else(material_floor == "wood",   1, material_floor_index)) %>%
  mutate(material_floor_index = if_else(material_floor == "cement", 2, material_floor_index)) %>%
  mutate(cgsol = rowSums(across(c(durable_goods_owned_mobile_phone,
                                   durable_goods_owned_radio,
                                   durable_goods_owned_television,
                                   durable_goods_owned_computer,
                                   durable_goods_owned_refrigerator,
                                   durable_goods_owned_generator,
                                   durable_goods_owned_bicycle,
                                   durable_goods_owned_motorcycle,
                                   durable_goods_owned_car_truck,
                                   durable_goods_owned_boat),
                                as.numeric),
                         na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  select(participant_id, cgsol, material_floor_index, material_wall_index,
         material_roof_index, waist_circumference)

## Cardiochek Data (n=393)----
cardiochek_data <- cardiochek_data |>
  ## dropping duplicate NSF7022 response....age doesn't match for R_mRIUzcXckCQEhdG
  filter(responseid!="R_mRIUzcXckCQEhdG") |> 
  filter(participant_id %in% study_participant_ids) |> 
  select(-c(survey_date, responseid, age, gender, consent)) |>
  select(-contains("category"))   |> 
  ## removing non-fasting samples
  filter(!grepl("eat", notes))

## CRP Data (n = 133) -----
crp_data <- crp_data |> 
  mutate(cv = as.numeric(cv),
         concentration_pg_ml_raw = as.numeric(concentration_pg_ml_raw),
         additional_dilution_factor = as.numeric(dilution),
         eluate_dilution = 167) |> 
  filter(cv<12,concentration_pg_ml_raw > 18.75,concentration_pg_ml_raw < 1200) |> 
  filter(!grepl("Control|Standard|Blank|Pool", sample_id),
         !(grepl("saturated", notes)),
         assay_number != 2) |> 
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() |> 
  rename(participant_id = sample_id) |> 
  filter(participant_id%in%study_participant_ids) |> 
  select(participant_id, additional_dilution_factor, concentration_pg_ml_raw) |> 
  filter(!is.na(concentration_pg_ml_raw)) |> 
  mutate(concentration_pg_ml_adjusted_for_dilutions = concentration_pg_ml_raw*additional_dilution_factor) |> 
  mutate(serum_equivalent_mg_L = 1E-6*((355.67*concentration_pg_ml_adjusted_for_dilutions)-59884.10))

## Actigraphy Summary (person-level) (n=103) ----
actigraphy_summary <- actigraphy_data |>
  filter(participant_id%in% study_participant_ids) |> 
  mutate(
    MVPA_min       = dur_day_total_MOD_min + dur_day_total_VIG_min,
    inactivity_min = dur_day_total_IN_min
  ) |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(
    mean_MVPA_min     = mean(MVPA_min,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_inactive_min = mean(inactivity_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid_days      = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Merging ----
### n = 267
full_dataset_long_survey <- cardiochek_data |>
  inner_join(food_data,               by = "participant_id") |>
  inner_join(long_survey_health_data,  by = "participant_id") |>
  inner_join(long_survey_sol_data,     by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(actigraphy_summary,        by = "participant_id") |> 
  left_join(crp_data,        by = "participant_id")

### n = 126
full_dataset_short_survey <- cardiochek_data |>
  inner_join(food_data,                by = "participant_id") |>
  inner_join(short_survey_health_data, by = "participant_id") |>
  inner_join(short_survey_sol_data,    by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(actigraphy_summary,        by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(crp_data,        by = "participant_id") |>
  mutate("body_fat" = NA, .after = "BMI")

### n = 393
full_dataset <- rbind(full_dataset_long_survey, full_dataset_short_survey) |>
  # hsol: sum raw ordinal scores across wall, roof, floor then scale once
  mutate(hsol = material_wall_index + material_floor_index + material_roof_index) |>
  mutate(
    cgsol_z = as.numeric(scale(cgsol)),   # substantive MI predictor: consumer goods
    hsol_z  = as.numeric(scale(hsol))     # control variable: housing quality
    # MI composite dropped: cgsol_z and hsol_z modeled separately
    # cgsol_z = active market participation (theoretically proximate mechanism)
    # hsol_z  = durable wealth accumulation (control for background SES)
  ) |>
  rename(crp = serum_equivalent_mg_L)
```

### SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: DROP MISSING VALUES (no censoring) ----
```{r}
# Observations below the limit of quantification (triglycerides < 50, HDL < 20,
# LDL not calculable) are treated as missing and excluded from each outcome's
# likelihood rather than being interval-censored. This is a complete-case
# sensitivity test of the primary censored model.

cat("N missing triglycerides:", sum(is.na(full_dataset$triglycerides)), "\n")
cat("N missing LDL cholesterol:", sum(is.na(full_dataset$ldl_cholesterol)), "\n")
cat("N missing HDL cholesterol:", sum(is.na(full_dataset$hdl_cholesterol)), "\n")
cat("N missing total cholesterol:", sum(is.na(full_dataset$total_cholesterol)), "\n")
```

## 1.3 Market food index

```{r ffq_market_index}
# ── Market food index ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Market/processed items
market_food_cols <- c(
  "total_bread", "total_pasta", "total_chips", "total_cookies_sweets",
  "total_soda", "total_beer", "total_butter_oil",
  "total_dairy"
)

ffq_market <- ffq_data |>
  mutate(across(all_of(market_food_cols), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(market_food_index = rowMeans(pick(all_of(market_food_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  select(participant_id, market_food_index)

full_dataset <- full_dataset |>
  left_join(ffq_market, by = "participant_id")
```


## 1.5 Analytic dataset

```{r model_data}

model_data <- full_dataset |>
  filter(participant_id %in% study_participant_ids) |> 
  mutate(
    log_BMI           = log(BMI),
    log_body_fat      = log(body_fat),
    market_food_index_raw = market_food_index,
    market_food_index = log(market_food_index + 1),
    log_mean_MVPA_min = log(mean_MVPA_min),
    log_MAP           = log(MAP),
    log_glucose       = log(glucose),
    log_hdl           = log(hdl_cholesterol),
    log_total_cholesterol = log(total_cholesterol),
    log_triglycerides = log(triglycerides),
    log_ldl           = log(ldl_cholesterol),
    log_crp           = log(crp),
    age_raw           = age,

  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(log_mean_MVPA_min,
                  market_food_index,
                  log_BMI,
                  log_body_fat,
                  log_MAP,
                  log_glucose,
                  log_crp,
                  log_hdl,
                  log_total_cholesterol,
                  log_ldl,
                  log_triglycerides,
                  age),
                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  mutate(
    gender          = case_when(
      gender == "Male"   ~ 1L,
      gender == "Female" ~ 0L,
      TRUE               ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    food_insecurity = as.integer(food_insecurity),
    village         = as.character(village)
  )

# Missingness summary
model_data |>
  summarise(
    n_total_chol_missing    = sum(is.na(total_cholesterol)),
    n_ldl_missing           = sum(is.na(ldl_cholesterol)),
    n_hdl_missing           = sum(is.na(hdl_cholesterol)),
    n_triglycerides_missing = sum(is.na(triglycerides)),
    n_glucose_missing = sum(is.na(glucose)),
    n_map_missing = sum(is.na(MAP)),
    n_ffq_missing = sum(is.na(market_food_index)),
    n_bmi_missing = sum(is.na(BMI)),
    n_age_missing = sum(is.na(age)),
    n_gender_missing = sum(is.na(gender)),
    n_hsol_missing = sum(is.na(hsol_z)),
    n_cgsol_missing = sum(is.na(cgsol_z)))

## Ensuring none of the duplicate participants ended up in the model df
exclusive_id_pairs <- list(
  c("A123", "A414"),
  c("A175", "A387"),
  c("A181", "A360"),
  c("A188", "A382"),
  c("A222", "A307")
)

for (pair in exclusive_id_pairs) {
  in_data <- pair %in% model_data$participant_id
  if (all(in_data)) {
    cat("VIOLATION:", pair[1], "and", pair[2], "both present\n")
  } else if (!any(in_data)) {
    cat("neither present:", pair[1], "/", pair[2], "\n")
  } else {
    cat("OK - exactly one present:", pair[which(in_data)], "\n")
  }
}


## will impute missing cardiochek biomarkers....dropping missing MAP, market food index, BMI

print("FINAL ANALYTICAL SAMPLE SIZE:")

cat("N missing LDL in model data:", sum(is.na(model_data$ldl_cholesterol)), "\n")
cat("N missing HDL in model data:", sum(is.na(model_data$hdl_cholesterol)), "\n")
```

# 2. Descriptive Plots

#### DEMOGRAPHICS TABLE
```{r demo_table}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Helper: mean (SD) string
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Continuous variables
continuous_summary <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(
    `Age (years)`       = mean_sd(age_raw),
    `House Construction` = mean_sd(hsol),
    `Commercial Goods` = mean_sd(cgsol),
    `Market Food Index` = mean_sd(market_food_index_raw)) |>
  pivot_longer(-village, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

sex_summary <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(
    `Female (%)`   = sprintf("%d%% (n=%d)", round((1 - mean(gender, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100), sum(gender == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Male (%)`   = sprintf("%d%% (n=%d)", round((mean(gender, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100), sum(gender, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-village, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

n_row <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(Value = as.character(n()), Variable = "N") %>%
  select(Variable, everything())

table_all <- bind_rows(continuous_summary,sex_summary, n_row) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = village, values_from = Value) %>%
  relocate(Variable)

final_table <- table_all %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Descriptive statistics by village") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Village") %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "")

final_table |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = Variable == "N"))
```

```{r biomarker_cutoffs}
cardiochek_stats <- model_data |>
mutate(
    high_total_cholesterol = ifelse(total_cholesterol >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    high_ldl_cholesterol   = ifelse(ldl_cholesterol >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    high_triglycerides     = ifelse(triglycerides >= 150, 1L, 0L),
    high_glucose           = ifelse(glucose >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    low_hdl_cholesterol    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & hdl_cholesterol < 40 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & hdl_cholesterol < 50 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_waste_circumference    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & waist_circumference >= 102 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & waist_circumference >= 88 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    high_cardiochek_binary = case_when(
      high_total_cholesterol == 1 | high_ldl_cholesterol == 1 |
        high_triglycerides == 1 | high_glucose == 1 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_bp_for_mets = ifelse(average_systolic >= 130 | average_diastolic >= 85, 1L, 0L)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metabolic_syndrome_score = rowSums(
      cbind(high_glucose, high_bp_for_mets, high_triglycerides, low_hdl_cholesterol, high_waste_circumference)
    ),
    metabolic_syndrome_binary = ifelse(metabolic_syndrome_score>=3, 1, 0)
  )
```

# 3. Primary Path Model: cgsol_z → Diet → Cardiometabolic Outcomes

## 3.1 Model fitting

```{r path_model, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Village random intercepts on all equations.
priors_path <- c(
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## market_food_index (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = marketfoodindex),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = marketfoodindex),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = marketfoodindex, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = marketfoodindex),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_BMI (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logBMI),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logBMI),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logBMI, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logBMI),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_MAP (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logMAP),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logMAP),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logMAP, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logMAP),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## Triglycerides (complete cases only; no censoring)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),         class = b,         resp = logtriglycerides),
  prior(normal(0, 2),         class = Intercept, resp = logtriglycerides),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),       class = sd,        resp = logtriglycerides, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1),       class = sigma,     resp = logtriglycerides),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_Glucose (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logglucose),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logglucose),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logglucose, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logglucose),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## LDL cholesterol (complete cases only; no censoring)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logldl),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logldl),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logldl, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logldl),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## HDL cholesterol (complete cases only; no censoring)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = loghdl),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = loghdl),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = loghdl, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = loghdl),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## Food insecurity (Bernoulli)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = b,         resp = foodinsecurity),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = foodinsecurity),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = foodinsecurity, group = village)
)

set.seed(24)
# # 
fit_path <- brm(
  formula =
    # a-path: MI → diet mediator
    bf(market_food_index ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    # gaussian outcome equations: direct (c) + mediated (b) paths
    bf(log_BMI ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    bf(log_MAP ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    bf(log_triglycerides ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    bf(log_glucose       ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    bf(log_ldl           ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    bf(log_hdl           ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village)) +

    # H1.2: food insecurity — bernoulli family
    bf(food_insecurity ~ cgsol_z + hsol_z + market_food_index + age + gender + (1 | village),
       family = bernoulli(link = "logit")) +
    set_rescor(FALSE),

  data    = model_data,
  family  = gaussian(),           # default family for all equations without explicit family
  prior   = priors_path,
  chains  = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, cores = 4, seed = 24,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9995, max_treedepth = 12)
)


saveRDS(fit_path, file = paste0(fits_dir, "fit_path_no_cens.rds"))

# fit_path <- readRDS(paste0(fits_dir, "fit_path_no_cens.rds"))

# ── Summaries ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fixef(fit_path, probs = c(0.055, 0.945))

# ── Indirect effects via posterior draws ──────────────────────────────────────
# indirect effect of MI on each outcome through market food index
# = a-path draw × b-path draw

draws <- as_draws_df(fit_path)

# a-path: cgsol_z → market_food_index (substantive MI predictor)
a <- draws$b_marketfoodindex_cgsol_z

indirect_effects <- tibble(
  BMI             = a * draws$b_logBMI_market_food_index,
  MAP             = a * draws$b_logMAP_market_food_index,
  triglycerides   = a * draws$b_logtriglycerides_market_food_index,
  glucose         = a * draws$b_logglucose_market_food_index,
  LDL             = a * draws$b_logldl_market_food_index,
  HDL             = a * draws$b_loghdl_market_food_index,
  food_insecurity = a * draws$b_foodinsecurity_market_food_index)

# Summarise: median + 89% CI + directional posterior probability
indirect_summary <- indirect_effects |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "indirect") |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(indirect),
    q5.5   = quantile(indirect, 0.055),
    q94.5  = quantile(indirect, 0.945),
    # direction depends on outcome: positive = worse for biomarkers, negative = better for FI
    p_pos  = mean(indirect > 0),
    p_neg  = mean(indirect < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(indirect_summary)



direct_effects <- tibble(
  BMI             = draws$b_logBMI_cgsol_z,
  MAP             = draws$b_logMAP_cgsol_z,
  triglycerides   = draws$b_logtriglycerides_cgsol_z,
  glucose         = draws$b_logglucose_cgsol_z,
  LDL             = draws$b_logldl_cgsol_z,
  HDL             = draws$b_loghdl_cgsol_z,
  food_insecurity = draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z)

# Summarise directional posterior probability
direct_summary <- direct_effects |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "direct") |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  summarise(
    p_pos  = mean(direct > 0),
    p_neg  = mean(direct < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(direct_summary)

## TOTAL EFFECTS OF MI ON FOOD INSECURITY
direct_draws_fi   <- draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z
indirect_draws_fi <- a * draws$b_foodinsecurity_market_food_index   # a = draws$b_marketfoodindex_cgsol_z

total_draws_fi <- direct_draws_fi + indirect_draws_fi

median(total_draws_fi)
quantile(total_draws_fi, c(0.055, 0.945))
mean(total_draws_fi > 0)  # p_pos
mean(total_draws_fi < 0)  # p_neg
```

## 3.2 Effect plots

```{r path_model_plots}
outcome_labels <- c(
  BMI        = "BMI",
  MAP             = "Mean Arterial Pressure",
  triglycerides   = "Triglycerides",
  glucose         = "Glucose",
  LDL             = "LDL Cholesterol",
  HDL             = "HDL Cholesterol",
  food_insecurity = "Food Insecurity (logit)")

col_direct   <- "#0072B2"
col_indirect <- "#E69F00"
col_total    <- "#CC79A7"

direct_draws <- tibble(
  BMI             = draws$b_logBMI_cgsol_z,
  MAP             = draws$b_logMAP_cgsol_z,
  triglycerides   = draws$b_logtriglycerides_cgsol_z,
  glucose         = draws$b_logglucose_cgsol_z,
  LDL             = draws$b_logldl_cgsol_z,
  HDL             = draws$b_loghdl_cgsol_z,
  food_insecurity = draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "estimate") |>
  mutate(effect_type = "Direct (Goods → Outcome)")

indirect_draws <- indirect_effects |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "estimate") |>
  mutate(effect_type = "Indirect (Goods → Diet → Outcome)")

# ── Total effects: direct + indirect ──────────────────────────────────────────
total_draws <- tibble(
  BMI             = draws$b_logBMI_cgsol_z             + indirect_effects$BMI,
  MAP             = draws$b_logMAP_cgsol_z             + indirect_effects$MAP,
  triglycerides   = draws$b_logtriglycerides_cgsol_z  + indirect_effects$triglycerides,
  glucose         = draws$b_logglucose_cgsol_z         + indirect_effects$glucose,
  LDL             = draws$b_logldl_cgsol_z             + indirect_effects$LDL,
  HDL             = draws$b_loghdl_cgsol_z             + indirect_effects$HDL,
  food_insecurity = draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z     + indirect_effects$food_insecurity) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "estimate") |>
  mutate(effect_type = "Total (Direct + Indirect)")

all_effects <- bind_rows(direct_draws, indirect_draws, total_draws) |>
  mutate(
    outcome     = factor(outcome, levels = names(outcome_labels), labels = outcome_labels),
    effect_type = factor(effect_type,
                         levels = c("Direct (Goods → Outcome)",
                                    "Indirect (Goods → Diet → Outcome)",
                                    "Total (Direct + Indirect)"))
  )

# ── Combined halfeye plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_main <- all_effects |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = outcome, fill = effect_type, color = effect_type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_halfeye(.width = 0.89, point_interval = median_qi,
               alpha = 0.75, normalize = "groups",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), slab_linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Direct (Goods → Outcome)"          = col_direct,
                                 "Indirect (Goods → Diet → Outcome)" = col_indirect,
                                 "Total (Direct + Indirect)"           = col_total), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Direct (Goods → Outcome)"          = col_direct,
                                 "Indirect (Goods → Diet → Outcome)" = col_indirect,
                                 "Total (Direct + Indirect)"           = col_total), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate", y = NULL,
       title    = "Effects of market integration on cardiometabolic health and food insecurity",
       subtitle = "Indirect pathway through market food consumption | 89% credibility intervals") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))
print(p_main)

ggsave("main_path_model.jpeg", path = "/Users/levkolinski/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EEID_Data_public/manuscripts/cardiometabolic_health_food_security/Figures/",
       units="in", width=10, height=7, dpi=350, device = "jpeg", bg = "white")



# ── Standalone plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_panel_main <- function(data, fill_col, title_str) {
  data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = outcome)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_halfeye(fill = fill_col, color = fill_col, .width = 0.89,
                 point_interval = median_qi, alpha = 0.75,
                 normalize = "panels", slab_linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    labs(x = "Posterior Estimate", y = NULL, title = title_str,
         subtitle = "89% credibility intervals") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))
}

p_direct_main   <- make_panel_main(
  all_effects |> filter(effect_type == "Direct (Goods → Outcome)"),
  col_direct,   "Direct Effects: Goods → Outcome")

p_indirect_main <- make_panel_main(
  all_effects |> filter(effect_type == "Indirect (Goods → Diet → Outcome)"),
  col_indirect, "Indirect Effects: Goods → Diet → Outcome")

p_total_main    <- make_panel_main(
  all_effects |> filter(effect_type == "Total (Direct + Indirect)"),
  col_total,    "Total Effects: Goods → Outcome")

print(p_direct_main)
print(p_indirect_main)
print(p_total_main)

# ── Three-panel split ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(p_direct_main + p_indirect_main + p_total_main +
  plot_annotation(title = "Market Integration Effects on Health Outcomes",
                  subtitle = "89% credible intervals | log-transformed outcomes",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
                                plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10))))
```

## 3.3 MCMC diagnostics and posterior predictive checks

```{r primary_diagnostics}
# ── Primary summaries: see path_model chunk above ─────────────────────────────
# All primary results (a-path, b-paths, c-paths, indirect effects, posterior
# probabilities) are produced within the path_model chunk. This chunk provides
# additional MCMC diagnostics and posterior predictive checks per outcome.

# MCMC diagnostics — Rhat < 1.01 and ESS > 400 for all parameters
print(fit_path, digits = 3)

plot(fit_path)
# Posterior predictive checks per outcome response
lapply(c("logBMI", "logMAP", "logtriglycerides", "logglucose",
          "logldl", "loghdl", "foodinsecurity"), function(resp) {
  pp_check(fit_path, resp = resp, ndraws = 50) +
    ggtitle(paste("PP check:", resp))
})
```
